name: Bastion: Gauntlet of the Chosen
detailed_description:
They say our world was built on a forgotten promise—and a lie so ancient, its truth is lost to time. The echoes of a golden age have long since faded, silenced by the iron grip of a new ruler. This truth lies buried deep beneath the foundations of the great Bastion, a monument of power ruled by a tyrant who is himself a mere puppet in a much older, cosmic game.

You are not the hero of this story. You are its victim. Torn from your home as the eldest of your siblings, you are thrown into the bloody arenas of the capital—a cruel fate shared with other lost souls: the indebted, the exiled, the innocent. Each one a story that will end in the sands of the arena. Or will it? For here, facing certain death, the veil of reality tears. You begin to see what truly lurks beneath the surface of this world and feel that your destiny is greater than mere survival.

AN ARENA THAT FIGHTS BACK

The arena is more than just sand and blood. It is an altar where the new order pays for its power with human lives. There are no health bars to grant you hope. A single mistake, a poorly parried blow, and your body breaks. Your only currency is instinct, sharpened by the screams of the dying and the scent of cold steel. Fight in merciless duels, survive chaotic mass brawls, or face savage beasts whose claws know no difference between champion and slave. Hear the crowd roar your name—or curse it. Their cheers are your currency; their contempt, your drive. Fight in arenas that turn against you: blinding sandstorms, collapsing ruins, and ancient traps awaiting a single misstep.

YOUR BODY IS THE CHRONICLE OF YOUR LIFE

Progress isn't measured in points, but in scars and memory. Your character learns and adapts, becoming a living weapon. As you wield a sword, your strikes become more precise with every fight, your stance firmer, your animations visibly more fluid. If you lurk in the shadows, your steps grow quieter, your senses sharper. If you endure the frozen wilds, your body hardens against the cold. You don't shape your character in a menu—you forge them in the crucible of experience.

A TRUTH MEANT TO BE FORGOTTEN

Your path leads you beyond the arena walls, into a world of deceptive beauty. In decaying temples and frozen deserts, you will find traces of those who walked this earth before the first man—beings of smokeless fire whose corruption was so vast they were banished from this world. You will hear the echoes of their whispers, which once devoured the sanity of pharaohs and kings. You will realize the fight against the Bastion's tyrant is but a single chapter in a war that has raged since the dawn of time. Every truth you uncover is a weapon. Every lie you uphold, an armor. But what will you use them for?

A SANDBOX OF CONSEQUENCE

There is no predestined path. No one will come and choose you as the hero. Your actions shape your reality. Will you become the glorious champion of the arena, showered with gold and courted by the tyrant as his mascot? Enjoy the feasts and the decadence while closing your eyes to the suffering that funds your luxury. Or will you seek out the rebellion? Then you must convince them you are not a spy. Join conspirators in musty cellars, learn to read secret signs, and risk everything for a faint hope of freedom. Every NPC is an individual with their own memory and personality. A single good deed can spread as a rumor and open doors. A single misdeed can drive a simple villager to wage a personal vendetta against you that lasts for years.

FEATURES

  • A True Sandbox Experience: Ignore the main story and live as a merchant, join the tyrant's ranks, or become the most wanted criminal in the land. Your freedom is absolute.

  • Revolutionary AI System: Experience a world where NPCs remember your deeds, talk about them, form relationships, move to new towns for their own reasons, and can plot personal revenge.

  • Brutal & Realistic Combat: Master a physics-based combat system with no health bars, where every hit has visible and tangible consequences.

  • Visual Character Evolution: Become a living weapon. Your skills improve passively through use, reflected in increasingly masterful animations.

  • Uncover a Cosmic Secret: Discover a deep, dark narrative inspired by ancient myths that will make you question your own sanity.

  • Forged in Unreal Engine 5: Traverse landscapes of breathtaking yet ominous beauty, brought to life with the latest technology.

The Bastion holds the truth of the past and the key to the future. Will you restore the lost legacy, or will you build your own kingdom upon the ruins of lies?

Add it to your wishlist now.

An important note from our development team:

The current in-game screenshots show a very early prototype (version 0.1) of our game. We are actively developing the gameplay and graphics further, so what is shown does not reflect the final experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is intended for mature audiences and contains content that some players may find disturbing. We wish to provide potential players with a clear understanding of what to expect, so they can make an informed decision.

Violence & Gore
The core of the game is an intense and brutal melee combat system designed for realism. Players should expect the following:

Frequent and explicit depictions of violence: Combat is fast-paced, relentless, and bloody.
Realistic Injuries: Instead of health bars, the game simulates complex damage. Hits result in visible wounds, deep cuts, and broken bones that directly affect the character's combat ability.
Gore & Dismemberment: It is possible for body parts, such as limbs, to be severed during combat. Blood loss is a core gameplay element and can lead to fainting.
Violence Against Animals: The game includes combat against wild animals such as lions or bears.
Sensitive Themes & Story
The story of "Bastion: Gauntlet of the Chosen" is set in a dark, oppressive, and morally complex world. The narrative deals with adult themes to portray a believable and profound world:

Tyranny & Oppression: The plot revolves around a brutal dictatorship that secures its power through violence, fear, and propaganda.
Slavery & Exploitation: The game world depicts a society where people are enslaved, treated as property, and exploited.
Themes of Sexual Exploitation: The story addresses the depravity of the ruling powers. This includes narrative themes and implications of sexual exploitation, such as people being treated as the "toys" of the wealthy. However, there are no explicit depictions of sexual acts or sexual assault. These themes serve exclusively to underscore the cruelty of the antagonists and the world.
Drug & Alcohol Use
The game world contains locations such as taverns where characters consume alcoholic beverages. Drug abuse is not a central theme of the game.

Self-harm is not a theme in this game.

We believe in offering our players a challenging, but above all, honest experience. The elements described above are part of the dark world you will be immersing yourself in.
